issue.create.title: Issue create
issue.create.summary: Create an issue with a title and kind.

issue.show.title: Issue show
issue.show.summary: Read the issue and only its live lease.

issue.list.title: Issue list
issue.list.summary: List issues; ready means open, dependencies closed and no live lease. Pass labels to keep only items that carry every one of them.

issue.comment.title: Issue comment
issue.comment.summary: Append a plain comment. Read it back with issue.comments.

issue.claim.title: Issue claim
issue.claim.summary: Acquire an open issue lease; supply actor, session and project through catalog.call. Replay uses the invocation request ID.

issue.renew.title: Issue renew
issue.renew.summary: Renew a live lease at its current generation; expired leases must be acquired again.

issue.ready.title: Issue ready
issue.ready.summary: Open issues with closed dependencies and no live lease; expired or released leases never hide ready work. Pass labels to keep only items that carry all of them. When /blocks/work/config/labelOrder is set, results sort by the first listed label an item carries, then by stored order.

issue.blocked.title: Issue blocked
issue.blocked.summary: Open issues with dependencies that are missing or not closed.

issue.stale.title: Issue stale
issue.stale.summary: Open issues with an expired, unreleased lease.

issue.events.title: Issue events
issue.events.summary: Read accepted issue and lease history.

issue.dep.title: Issue dep
issue.dep.summary: Add or remove a dependency at an expected revision while holding the issue lease.

issue.link.title: Issue link
issue.link.summary: Attach a typed external link while holding the issue lease.

issue.lint.title: Issue lint
issue.lint.summary: Report invalid kinds, missing references and dependency cycles.
